title: Group-Equivariant Poincar\'e Convolutional Networks
abstract: arXiv:2607.00556v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While recent methods like that of the Poincar\'e ResNet have demonstrated the ability to learning visual representations directly in hyperbolic space, their optimisation remains a challenge, primarily due to the parameter redundancy of learning distinct orientation filters. In addition, hyperbolic learning exhibits distinct computational overheads that limit their wide use, where efforts to improve their efficiency via optimisation have seen good success, there has been limited exploration into structural priors that enable stronger sample efficiency at training. To address this, we propose Equivariant Poincar\'e ResNets, combining hyperbolic geometry with discrete symmetry groups ($C_4$ and $D_4$). translated_title: 群等变的庞加莱卷积网络
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.00556v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：虽然像庞加莱残差网络（Poincaré ResNet）这样的近期方法展示了直接在双曲空间中学习视觉表示的能力，但其优化仍然是一个挑战，主要原因是学习不同方向滤波器时存在参数冗余。此外，双曲学习表现出独特的计算开销，限制了其广泛应用，尽管通过优化提升其效率的努力已取得良好成功，但在利用结构先验以增强训练时的样本效率方面探索有限。为解决这一问题，我们提出了等变庞加莱残差网络（Equivariant Poincaré ResNets），将双曲几何与离散对称群（$C_4$ 和 $D_4$）相结合。我们识别了将欧几里得等变性应用于双曲空间的关键障碍，并提出了几何安全的张量重塑、用于双曲群卷积的左正则置换，以及联合方向的庞加莱混合（Joint-orientation Poincaré Mixture）。
tldr: 本文提出等变庞加莱残差网络，通过结合双曲几何与离散对称群，并引入几何安全的张量重塑和左正则置换等新方法，解决了双曲空间中应用等变性的关键障碍，显著提升了样本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Equivariant Poincaré ResNets that combine hyperbolic geometry with discrete symmetry groups, introducing geometrically safe tensor reshaping and left-regular permutations to overcome key obstacles in applying equivariance to hyperbolic space, thereby enhancing sample efficiency.
